details: Owner, verbatim: "Добавь в очередь пункт про предел за день в relay". On 24 Oct the cap was raised three times ($75, $100, $200) and lived only in Claude's memory; the day's spend ("about $70") was an estimate from the handover, since no command sums it. Another machine or session without that memory has no cap at all.
failing_case: 24 Oct: no relay command prints the day's paid spend; the cap $200 is written only in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-amidman-relay/memory/paid-checks-preapproved.md; bin/paid-cost has only `ceiling` and `estimate`.
pass_cases: `bin/paid-cost today` on fixture records prints the summed spend, the run count and the cap; a paid bin/ci or relay bench whose estimate would pass the cap is refused before it starts with that line; with spend + estimate under the cap it runs; the cap is read from projects.toml, not from Claude memory.
